name: Intrinsic Cognitive Load
fact: Intrinsic cognitive load is determined by the inherent complexity of the material being learned, specifically the level of element interactivity within that material.

provenance.title: Why Some Material Is Difficult to Learn
provenance.quote_or_locus: High levels of element interactivity and their associated cognitive loads may be caused both by intrinsic nature of the material being learned and by the method of presentation
